item.title: Derived schemes and the cotangent complex of a morphism
item.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice inherited from the cotangent-comparison suppliers used in the cotangent portion ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). A derived scheme is a pair $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ consisting of a topological space X and a sheaf of simplicial commutative rings $\mathcal O_X$ such that $(X,\pi_0\mathcal O_X)$ is a scheme and each $\pi_i\mathcal O_X$, $i>0$, is a quasi-coherent module on that scheme ([[def-simplicial-object-and-simplicial-commutative-ring]], [[def-scheme]], [[def-quasi-coherent-module-scheme]]). Morphisms are taken in the homotopical category of derived locally ringed spaces and induce local morphisms on truncations. A scheme embeds as the constant/discrete derived scheme via $i:\mathit{Sch}\to\mathit{dSch}$. The truncation $t_0(X)=(X,\pi_0\mathcal O_X)$ is right adjoint to this fully faithful inclusion: $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathit{dSch}}(iY,X)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathit{Sch}}(Y,t_0X)$, with the right side discrete. The counit is the canonical morphism $j_X:i(t_0X)\to X$. For a morphism of derived schemes $f:X\to Y$, the cotangent complex $L_{X/Y}$ is a quasi-coherent derived $\mathcal O_X$-module, obtained by gluing the affine derived cotangent complexes: on $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ for derived rings it is the B-module cotangent complex representing relative derived derivations. For discrete ordinary A and B this is the ordinary ring-map complex of [[def-cotangent-complex-of-a-ring-map]], whose resolution/base-change comparisons are commissioned in [[lem-cotangent-complex-resolution-independence]]. The derived pullback $j_X^*L_{X/Y}$ is a complex of $\pi_0\mathcal O_X$-modules on $t_0X$; it must be distinguished from the full derived $\mathcal O_X$-module $L_{X/Y}$. Its homology and shifts use [[def-homology-object-of-a-chain-complex]] and [[def-shift-of-a-chain-complex]]. These constructions require genuine homotopical module and cotangent comparisons, not merely applying the ordinary-ring definition to non-discrete simplicial rings.
item.strategy:
Full commissioned definition and corrected variance, with its remaining global foundational premises owner-held. On rings, discrete inclusion has left adjoint pi0; reversing affine spectra makes scheme inclusion left adjoint and t0 right adjoint, with canonical t0(X)->X. The full cotangent module is over derived O_X, while its pullback along that map is over pi0(O_X); neither portion is replaced by truncation. The ordinary comparison, exact DK, strict algebra adjunctions and ten local model/corner/enriched/diagram/affine helpers are actual supplied proof routes. In particular the fixed-base affine representative is obtained from the cofibrant free-cell model by the actual enriched square-zero/indecomposable adjunction, with its ordinary discrete polynomial bridge.

Further independently reviewed local construction (complete arguments retained in owner-group-actions/derived-final-proof-route.md): bisimplicial diagonal and total are identified by the actual representable-resolution/evaluation roofs on Delta times Delta, with product simplices explicitly contracted by H(i,0)=0,H(i,1)=i. The resulting tensor comparison makes ordinary termwise-free simplicial Z-modules homotopically flat. Module cells have quotient A tensor_Z Z[Delta n]/Z[boundary Delta n]. Algebra cells are filtered by degree in complementary new variables, with gr_r=P_old tensor_Z Sym^r of that quotient; the filtration splits degreewise, survives tensor, and filtered unions are exact. This proves cofibrant module/algebra tensor-flatness. Weak coefficient-base extension units are therefore weak equivalences; actual enriched adjunction proves weak-base equivalence, and additive normalized pullbacks prove right properness/target-slice comparison. The concrete noncofibrant affine undercategory obstruction is removed in this enriched model by a cofibrant base replacement and these comparisons.

The projective-span mapping property plus the square-zero homotopy pullback gives canonical affine cotangent homotopy base change; chain restriction of derived derivations gives transitivity. Exact degreewise simplicial localization commutes with normalized homology. Ordinary polynomial localization has zero cotangent by the proved ordinary comparison; presenting simplicial localization as that polynomial-ring homotopy pushout proves general localization vanishing. Transitivity gives B_T tensor_B^L L_B/A = L_B_T/A_S when the target inverts the source set, including both shrinking charts. All-lifting-squares cell resolutions are strictly natural on the entire coefficient-arrow category and commute with filtered colimits, since each boundary/simplex square is finite data. Differentials and tensor have the same finite-presentation property. Their single sheafified cotangent module has the computed cofibrant germs and affine/quasi-coherent chart comparisons for a specified strict chart presentation. This discharges those local algebra/localization interfaces; it does not construct the remaining global local model.

Conditional global construction, with hypotheses retained explicitly: in projective/local hypercomplete variable-ring/module presheaf models, Q(C)=B tensor_C Omega_C/A is globally enriched left adjoint to square-zero R(M)=B plus M. It sends augmented free-algebra hypercover maps exactly to free-module hypercover maps. If the local models and hypercomplete target B exist, a locally fibrant M gives a locally fibrant B plus M. Thus for a cofibrant P->B, Map(QP,M^f)=Map(P,B plus M^f) is the actual global local-derived derivation representation. A representable-cell resolution compares strictly to the sectionwise all-squares resolution by sending each restricted attaching square to its indexed local cell; the comparison is objectwise weak, and sheafification preserves its germs. Raw sections/stalkwise universality are not substituted for this fibrant-target argument.

Precise remaining owner hold: the non-additive Kan-Quillen/Ex-infinity/finitary/Cartesian/left-properness KS package is not supplied locally; the reviewed topological-site recognition/hypercover/presheaf-sheaf proof is conditional on it. Actual local variable simplicial ring/module models, stalk-equivalence/hypercover-fibrancy characterization and ring/module local transfer are still unproved, including their identification with derived locally ringed-space maps and valid strict affine chart presentations. The constructed K is connective; its realization and universal mapping property in the commissioned full stable derived sheaf-module/mapping-spectrum framework also remain unproved. Fixed-ring DK is insufficient for that variable-ring stable sheaf comparison. Full commissioned statements, shifts and pullback distinction are retained. General HS strictification/arbitrary QCoh hyperdescent is not an irreducible commissioned claim and is not imported as a proved theorem. Exact source/argument acceptance and blockers are in owner-group-actions/derived-final-review.md and derived-blocker-map.json.
